sections.title: MID MS/OH VALLEY AREA TODAY
sections.text: SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING IN THE SLIGHT RISK AREA THIS MORNING ACROSS NRN MO/WRN IL AND FROM SE INDIANA INTO SW OH. THE ERN CLUSTER OF ELEVATED STORMS HAS BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA ON THE NOSE OF 30-40 KT WLY LLJ...ON THE ERN EDGE OF THE STEEP LAPSE RATE PLUME EMANATING FROM THE CENTRAL PLAINS/ROCKIES. FARTHER W IN MO/IL...LOW-LEVEL WAA AND ASCENT ALONG SEVERAL GUST FRONTS FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION CONTINUE TO MAINTAIN STRONG/SEVERE STORMS THIS MORNING. THE 12Z ILX SOUNDING SHOWS A VERY UNSTABLE AND ONLY WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT AHEAD OF THE ONGOING MO/IL STORMS...THUS THESE STORMS SHOULD PERSIST THROUGH THE MORNING WHILE MOVING GENERALLY EWD. OTHER DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE DURING THE DAY BETWEEN THE WRN IL AND INDIANA STORM CLUSTERS...ALONG THE STALLED SURFACE FRONT WHERE INSTABILITY IS MAXIMIZED /MLCAPE NEAR 4000 J/KG/. THE COMBINATION OF MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR ALONG THE SRN EDGE OF THE 30+ KT WLY/WNWLY MID LEVEL FLOW...POSSIBLY AUGMENTED BY EMBEDDED MCV/S EMERGING FROM THE MO/IL CONVECTION...AND STRONG INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH THE DAY ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA...WITH THE STRONGEST STO

sections.title: WRN NEB/SD AND NE WY AREA THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: SUBTLE MID LEVEL SPEED MAXIMA WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE ESEWD FROM MT ON THE SWRN PERIPHERY OF THE NRN STREAM TROUGH OVER CANADA...AND EWD FROM ID TO WY AROUND THE NWRN EXTENSION OF THE SRN ROCKIES MID LEVEL RIDGE. MEANWHILE...MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW WILL BECOME ESTABLISHED TODAY INTO TONIGHT ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS IN THE WAKE OF A COLD FRONT MOVING SWD ACROSS NEB. THE COMBINATION OF BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S AND SURFACE HEATING OVER THE ELEVATED TERRAIN SHOULD ALLOW A FEW THUNDERSTORMS TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS THE ERN WY VICINITY. VERTICAL SHEAR AND INSTABILITY WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS AS THE CONVECTION APPROACHES THE SD/NEB BORDER REGION...WHERE THE STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. THE STORMS COULD THEN PERSIST INTO THE EVENING AND OVERNIGHT HOURS AS LOW-LEVEL WAA INCREASES WITH THE DEVELOPMENT OF A 20-30 KT SLY/SSELY LLJ.

sections.title: CENTRAL/ERN ORE THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: SOME LOW-MID LEVEL DRYING HAS BEEN NOTED THE PAST 1-2 DAYS FROM NE CA/NW NV INTO SRN ORE. INSTABILITY WILL LIKELY BE REDUCED SOMEWHAT THIS AFTERNOON COMPARED TO A FEW DAYS AGO...EVEN THOUGH THE LARGE SCALE PATTERN IS RELATIVELY UNCHANGED WITH THE CLOSED LOW OFF THE CA COAST AND THE RIDGE EXTENDING NWWD FROM THE SRN ROCKIES TO THE GREAT BASIN. STILL...AT LEAST ISOLATED STORMS SHOULD FORM AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON WITH HEATING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN...AND THE STRONGEST STORMS MAY PRODUCE HAIL AND GUSTY OUTFLOW WINDS. ..THOMPSON/GARNER.. 08/04/2009

sections.title: OH VALLEY REGION INTO TN VALLEY AND WWD ACROSS THE OZARKS
sections.text: PRIMARY CONCERN FOR THIS REGION WILL CONTINUE TO FOCUS ON BOWING MCS/POSSIBLE DERECHO PERSISTING INTO FAR WRN IND AT 16Z...AS WELL AS IMPACTS FROM EARLIER MCS/PERSISTENT WAA DEVELOPMENT AHEAD OF IT INTO NERN KY AND SWRN OH/SERN IND. APPEARS PRIMARY CORRIDOR OF SEVERE THREAT...MAINLY IN THE FORM OF PSBLY WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS...WILL PROGRESS ESEWD ACROSS CENTRAL IND THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON ALONG OUTFLOW FROM EARLIER ACTIVITY. LONGEVITY OF THIS SYSTEM WILL DEPEND UPON RECOVERY OF AIR MASS INTO THE OH VALLEY REGION OF SRN OH/NRN KY AS MOMENTUM/WLY COMPONENT OF MEAN FLOW ADVECTS THE SYSTEM MORE ESEWD...AND/OR A TURN TO A MORE SSEWD MOTION AS PROPAGATION INTO GREATER INSTABILITY BEGINS TO DOMINATE. SHOULD SYSTEM TURN...THREAT WOULD THEN SHIFT MORE SWD INTO CENTRAL/ERN KY AND TN AND POSSIBLY PERSIST WELL INTO THE EVENING...ALTHOUGH THERE MAY BE A TEMPORARY LULL IN WIND DAMAGE THREAT LATER THIS AFTERNOON AS THE SYSTEM TURNS MORE SSEWD AND ADDITIONAL COOL POOL MOMENTUM BECOMES ESTABLISHED. FARTHER WEST INTO THE LOWER OH RIVER VALLEY AND TOWARDS SERN KS/SRN MO/NRN OK...A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THROUGH THE DAY ALONG SURFACE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SHIFTING INTO SRN MO

sections.title: WRN NEB/SD AND NE WY AREA THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: AREA WILL REMAIN UNDER MODEST WNWLY FLOW ALOFT ALONG PERIPHERY OF MID/UPPER LEVEL RIDGE OVER THE CENTRAL/SRN ROCKIES. AT THE SURFACE...LOW LEVELS REMAIN FAIRLY MOIST WITH 50+F SURFACE DEW POINTS EXPECTED TO PERSIST WITHIN UPSLOPE FLOW PATTERN INTO ERN WY AND THE HIGH PLAINS OF WRN SD/NEB. THIS SHOULD SUPPORT AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY THIS AFTERNOON...AND INCREASE STORM COVERAGE/INTENSITY ALONG AND EAST OF HIGHER TERRAIN BY LATE IN THE DAY. FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATE SUFFICIENT SHEAR/INSTABILITY FOR SUPERCELLS AS THE CONVECTION SHIFTS ACROSS LOWER ELEVATIONS THROUGH THE EVENING...WITH ATTENDANT THREATS OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES. THE STORMS COULD THEN PERSIST INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS AS LOW-LEVEL WAA INCREASES WITH THE DEVELOPMENT OF A 20-30 KT SLY/SSELY LLJ...WITH SEVERE THREAT TRANSITIONING MORE TO HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: SHARPENING MID/UPPER LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE GREAT LAKES WILL SHIFT NOSE OF 50+ KT MID JET ACROSS SURFACE COLD FRONT MOVING EWD INTO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION TODAY. COMBINATION OF FRONTAL LIFTING AND DEEP ASCENT WILL OVERSPREAD AXIS OF MARGINAL TO MODERATE INSTABILITY AND SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AND SMALL LINES OF FAST MOVING STORMS EWD ACROSS THIS REGION LATER TODAY AND THIS EVENING. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE PRIMARY THREATS... ALTHOUGH A BRIEF TORNADO COULD OCCUR AS WELL. STORMS SHOULD WEAKEN WITH EWD EXTENT THIS EVENING AS ACTIVITY SHIFTS EAST OF NARROW INSTABILITY AXIS.

sections.title: PORTIONS OH/TN VALLEYS WWD ACROSS THE OZARKS
sections.text: MID AFTERNOON SATELLITE IMAGERY AND REGIONAL RADARS SHOWED LEADING EDGE OF COLD CLOUD TOPS AND STRONGER REFLECTIVITY...RESPECTIVELY... HAD SHIFTED INTO KY. MODERATE TO VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS EXTENDED GENERALLY E-W FROM THE SRN APPALACHIANS WWD THROUGH SRN MO/AR INTO OK...WITH THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY LOCATED OVER SERN MO/NERN AR INTO WRN KY/TN WHERE SURFACE DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 70S F. THIS CORRIDOR OF INSTABILITY WAS LOCATED S OF THE ONGOING OH VALLEY MCS AND ALONG AND S OF A COLD FRONT...WHICH AT 18Z EXTENDED FROM IL SWWD THROUGH CENTRAL MO TO FAR NRN OK. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A COUPLE OF SHORT WAVE TROUGHS MOVING INTO THE LOWER OH/TN VALLEYS COMBINED WITH THE INSTABILITY AND STRONGER BAND OF WNWLY WINDS SPREADING SEWD WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON/ EVENING. THIS OUTLOOK HAS SHIFTED THE HIGHER SEVERE PROBABILITIES FOR WIND AND HAIL SWD FROM SERN MO/NERN AR INTO CENTRAL KS/MIDDLE TN. FARTHER E...LOW LEVEL WAA ACROSS ERN KY/TN INTO THE APPALACHIANS WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG AND IN ADVANCE OF THE ONGOING MCS...BUT WEAKER DEEP LAYER SHEAR MAY TEND TO LIMIT THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT ACROSS THE FAR ERN EXTENT OF THE SL

sections.title: WRN INTO UPSTATE NY/NWRN VT
sections.text: MOIST/MODERATELY UNSTABLE PRE-FRONTAL AIR MASS EXTENDING DOWNSTREAM IN LEE OF THE LOWER GREAT LAKES TO SAINT LAWRENCE RIVER VALLEY SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR ONGOING TSTM CLUSTERS ALONG THE FRONT COULD AFFECT PARTS OF WRN INTO UPSTATE NY AND NWRN VT LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. SOME INCREASE IN EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR EAST OF LAKES ERIE/ONTARIO WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED STORMS WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. ASIDE FROM REMOVING PARTS OF CENTRAL NY AND FAR NWRN PA FROM THE SLIGHT RISK AREA WHERE INSTABILITY IS WEAKER...THE SLIGHT RISK AREA ALONG AND IN LEE OF THE LOWER GREAT LAKES HAS REMAINED THE SAME.

sections.title: MID MS/TN VALLEYS
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF CONVECTION -- INCLUDING A FAST-MOVING/BOWING BAND OF STORMS NOW MOVING INTO NWRN TN -- CONTINUES SHIFTING SSEWD INTO AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. WITH NWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW ATOP A WSWLY LOW-LEVEL JET...EXPECT STORMS TO REMAIN VIGOROUS AS THEY SHIFT SEWD ACROSS TN TOWARD NRN MS/NRN AL. WHILE HAIL REMAINS POSSIBLE...GREATEST SEVERE POTENTIAL WILL BE DAMAGING WINDS. THE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE FOR SEVERAL HOURS...AND MAY BUILD WWD ACROSS MO WITH TIME AS LOW-LEVEL JET INCREASES COINCIDENT WITH AN AXIS OF 2500 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE.

sections.title: HIGH PLAINS FROM ERN WY INTO SWRN SD/WRN NEB
sections.text: SMALL-SCALE/ARCING LINE OF STORMS IS MOVING OUT OF NERN WY INTO SWRN SD ATTM...WHERE AROUND 1500 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE IS IN PLACE. WITH SELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW ADVECTING BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE NWWD INTO THE ONGOING STORMS...EXPECT CONVECTION TO REMAIN VIGOROUS/SEVERE THIS EVENING AS THE STORMS SPREAD SEWD WITH TIME ACROSS SWRN SD AND WRN NEB. ALONG WITH THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL...STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS CAN BE EXPECTED.

sections.title: PAC NW EWD ACROSS THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION
sections.text: POCKETS OF MODERATE DESTABILIZATION ARE EVIDENT THIS AFTERNOON FROM ERN OREGON EWD INTO SRN MT/NRN WY. WHILE THE STRONGEST STORMS ARE MOVING OUT OF NERN WY ATTM...OTHER ISOLATED/STRONG CELLS CONTINUE ACROSS NERN OREGON...PARTS OF SRN ID...AND INTO S CENTRAL MT. WITH SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF SOME ORGANIZATION...AN ISOLATED/5% SEVERE POTENTIAL PERSISTS -- AND MAY LAST INTO MID-EVENING ACROSS THIS REGION.

sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES INTO UPSTATE NY
sections.text: SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE CROSSING THE LOWER GREAT LAKES/UPSTATE NEW YORK REGION...WITH A FEW STRONGER/LOCALLY-SEVERE CELLS PERSISTING. WHILE SHEAR/INSTABILITY REMAIN SUFFICIENT FOR AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT ATTM...STABILIZATION OF THE AIRMASS THIS EVENING SHOULD LEAD TO A SLOW DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE INTENSITY -- ALREADY UNDERWAY PER WARMING CLOUD TOPS IN LATEST IR LOOP. ..GOSS.. 08/05/2009

RADAR MOSAIC TRENDS OVER THE PAST HOUR SHOW FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS OVER THE MIDDLE OH RIVER VALLEY CONTINUES TO MOVE SEWD INTO PARTS OF WV AND ERN KY. IN ITS WAKE
